user_query: I'm planning a surprise party for my best friend's birthday. Can you suggest some Chuck Norris jokes and interesting math facts to entertain the guests? Also, provide a trivia fact about the year 2000 to add some fun to the party. Lastly, recommend a good venue in town for the celebration.

TaskList.description: Fetch a list of Chuck Norris jokes for entertainment.
Fetch interesting math facts for the party.
Fetch a trivia fact about the year 2000.
Find a good venue for the surprise party in town.
